subject.title: Add session workspace file preview editing

question: Should OpenClaw accept an admin-scoped `sessions.files.set` method that can create or overwrite text files under the session workspace after this PR is ported to the current chat UI?
rationale: The code appears bounded by admin scope and fs-safe helpers, but adding a new workspace write RPC is a product/security-boundary choice that automation should not approve by itself.

options.title: Accept after rebase
options.body: Keep the admin-only text writer and require the contributor to port the UI changes onto the current chat workspace components before merge.

options.title: Narrow the writer
options.body: Require a smaller write policy, such as saving only already-previewed/touched text files, before accepting the new RPC.

options.title: Defer core editing
options.body: Pause or close the PR if in-product session workspace editing should live outside core or wait for a different product direction.

recommendation.title: Accept after rebase
recommendation.body: Keep the admin-only text writer and require the contributor to port the UI changes onto the current chat workspace components before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main chat workspace and Gateway helper refactor is the code path this PR now needs to align with.
